summary.text: Jonathan Cooper is a Democratic state representative from Vermont who has represented the Bennington-1 District since January 2025 and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works as a program manager.

paragraphs.text: Jonathan Cooper earned a bachelor's degree from St. John's College and graduate degrees from the Conway School of Landscape Design and the University of Massachusetts, Amherst.
His career experience includes working as a program manager.
He has served on the boards of the Sunrise Family Resource Center and the Southern Vermont Economic Development Zone.
Cooper succeeded Nelson Brownell in the Vermont House of Representatives in 2025 and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
